mapper.insert: insert into act_hi_identityLink( id_, task_id_, type_, user_id_, create_time_ )values( #{id}, #{taskId}, #{type}, #{userId}, current_timestamp )
mapper.delete: delete from act_hi_comment where task_id_ = #{taskId} and action_ = 'AddComment'
mapper.select:
SELECT t1.ID_,t1.NAME_,t1.CREATE_TIME_,t1.ASSIGNEE_,t1.DESCRIPTION_, t1.TASK_DEF_KEY_,t1.CATEGORY_,t2.BUSINESS_KEY_,t2.PROC_INST_ID_, t2.PARENT_ID_,t2.PROC_DEF_ID_,t2.NAME_ AS form_name, t2.START_TIME_,t2.START_USER_ID_ AS start_person_code, t3.process_status,t5.USER_ID_ as user_id FROM act_ru_task t1 INNER JOIN act_ru_execution t2 ON t1.PROC_INST_ID_ = t2.PROC_INST_ID_ INNER JOIN tbl_flow_extend_procinst t3 ON t2.PROC_INST_ID_ = t3.proc_ins_id LEFT JOIN act_ru_identitylink t5 ON t5.TASK_ID_ = t1.ID_ LEFT JOIN sys_user t6 ON t6.user_id ::varchar = t2.START_USER_ID_
where 1 = 1
AND ( t1.ASSIGNEE_ = #{params.userCode} OR ( ( t1.ASSIGNEE_ IS NULL OR t1.ASSIGNEE_ = '' ) AND ( t5.USER_ID_ = #{params.userCode} OR t5.GROUP_ID_ IN ( select r.role_id ::varchar FROM sys_user_role r WHERE r.user_id ::varchar = #{params.userCode}))))
ORDER BY t1.CREATE_TIME_ ASC
